SELECT DISTINCT mc.id, mc.main_category_name
FROM main_categories mc
INNER JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.main_category_id = mc.id
INNER JOIN child_categories cc ON cc.sub_category_id = sc.id
INNER JOIN products p ON p.child_category_id = cc.id
INNER JOIN store_products sp ON sp.product_id = p.id
WHERE sp.store_id = #{storeId}
ORDER BY mc.id
